verdict.rationale: Verification funnel analytics is a fair question for an identity-verification product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no pass-rate, drop-off, or completion-time reporting broken down by country or document type. It shows only per-session tracking, webhooks and programmatic result access, which are building blocks a developer could use to construct such analytics, plus a list of test sessions in the dashboard.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see verification funnel analytics — pass rates, drop-off points, completion time by country and document type — to know what verification is costing me in signups
